definitions.explanation: A ticket that grants entry to a venue such as a concert hall, museum, stadium, or train station platform.

examples.japanese: {入場券|にゅうじょうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
{入場券|にゅうじょうけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧{五百円|ごひゃくえん}です。
examples.english: Admission tickets are 500 yen per adult.

examples.japanese: {入場券|にゅうじょうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せて→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I showed my ticket and then entered the venue.

notes:
{入場券|にゅうじょうけん} is a ticket that grants entry to a venue such as a museum, stadium, concert hall, or train station platform. In Japan, train stations sell {入場券|にゅうじょうけん} to people who want to enter the platform area without riding a train, for example to see someone off.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{入場|にゅうじょう}→入場：03521_nyuujou⟧ (admission, entry) + ⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧ (ticket)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入場券|にゅうじょうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to buy an admission ticket)
- {入場券|にゅうじょうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧ (to show an admission ticket)
- {入場券|にゅうじょうけん}⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧ (ticket counter)
- ⟦{当日|とうじつ}→当日：04558_toujitsu⟧{入場券|にゅうじょうけん} (same-day admission ticket)

RELATED TICKET WORDS:
- ⟦{乗車券|じょうしゃけん}→乗車券：05298_joushaken⟧ (train/bus ticket)
- ⟦{食券|しょっけん}→食券：19934_shokken⟧ (meal ticket)
- ⟦{商品券|しょうひんけん}→商品券：22121_shouhinken⟧ (gift certificate)
- ⟦{入場料|にゅうじょうりょう}→入場料：07056_nyuujouryou⟧ (admission fee — the price, not the physical ticket)
